Our Story ↓
Our Story

Started by two friends, on a single court.

Most people weren't there to become athletes. They came for a game with friends after work, a warm weekend afternoon, a new friendship along the way. Winning matters. But what brings people back is something else — the laughter, the people beside them, the time that feels entirely their own.

That's when we asked a different question: what if pickleball could be more than a sport?

We thought about golf. People remember more than the swing — the grass, the clothing, the clubhouse, the afternoons with friends. When a sport becomes a culture, it means something beyond winning. We believe pickleball can become that too.

So we decided to start again. Not just another sports brand — but a paddle bag you'd still carry into a café. Clothing you'd still wear after the game. Products that are functional without ever sacrificing beauty. Because function and taste should never be a choice.

Pickleball culture in America is only just beginning. That's exactly why we choose to begin now. We were here when the story was still small. Started by two friends. Started on a single court. And from there, we began creating a new way of life — together.

Ivan & Patrick
Founders, PHILIA

PHILIA LIGHT™

Lightweight performance eyewear designed specifically for pickleball.

PHILIA LIGHT™ combines a lightweight frameless construction with interchangeable performance lenses, wide peripheral vision, UV protection, and ventilation designed to reduce fogging during play. The design focuses on clarity, comfort, speed, and a distinctive modern appearance.

Through the Lens · EOS™

The design.

PHILIA LIGHT™ was drawn from the way pickleball is actually played — close to the net, in changing light, among friends. The frameless lower edge keeps the court open at the kitchen line. Carbon temples carry the weight back off the nose. The magnetic lens system lets the glasses change with the hour rather than the season.

Nothing on the frame announces itself. One engraved mark on the temple, one material story, and a silhouette that reads as considered rather than technical — eyewear you would keep on walking off the court.

PHILIA AIR™
